categories.main_business_segments: Suzhou Tianlu Optical Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of light guide plates, which are core components of backlight modules used in LCD display devices. The company also operates in the high polymer optical film sector, particularly producing TAC films, which are key raw materials for polarizers in display panels. Its business segments include light guide plates for desktop monitors, notebook computers, LCD TVs, and other display devices, as well as the emerging TAC film business through its subsidiary Anhui Jiguang New Materials Co., Ltd.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced optical theory, mathematical modeling, simulation, and statistical analysis for R&D of light guide plates. Production methods include hot pressing with laser-engraved steel molds and printing processes using high-diffusion materials like SiO2 and TiO2. The TAC film production involves polymer film formulation and equipment installation, with ongoing R&D to break foreign monopolies and achieve domestic high-end membrane material breakthroughs.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major global and domestic display panel manufacturers and brands such as BOE, China Electronics, AUO, Xiaomi, Samsung, Lenovo, HP, Huawei, Dell, LG, Sharp, and others. The end markets served are desktop monitors, notebook computers, LCD TVs, and other display devices. The company also targets high-value-added sectors like automotive and industrial control displays.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and main production facilities in Suzhou, Jiangsu Province. It has subsidiaries in Guangzhou, Hong Kong, and Anhui Province. Domestic sales account for the majority of revenue, with a growing export business contributing over 12% of sales. The company benefits from the global shift of display panel manufacturing capacity to mainland China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Tianlu Technology operates mainly in the midstream segment of the display panel supply chain, producing core precision components such as light guide plates and TAC films used in backlight modules and polarizers. The company is expanding upstream into high polymer optical films (TAC films) to enhance vertical integration and reduce reliance on imports.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes innovation in light guide plate technology, focusing on thinner, brighter, energy-efficient products with advanced prism dot technology to improve display brightness by 5-12%. It is investing heavily in TAC film R&D and production to localize supply and break foreign monopolies. Strategic plans include expanding into high-end membrane materials, enhancing automation and information systems in production, and deepening collaboration with upstream and downstream partners.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of light guide plates and optical films to display panel manufacturers and brand customers. The company operates on a product sales model with customized orders, mainly via direct sales channels. It also receives government subsidies and investment income from financial assets, but these are ancillary to core product sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders in TAC films like Fujifilm and Konica Minolta, which dominate about 75% of the global market. In light guide plates, Tianlu holds a strong position domestically with a diversified product portfolio and advanced technology, serving top-tier customers. It aims to strengthen its market share by leveraging technological innovation and vertical integration to challenge foreign dominance in high-end optical materials.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Tianlu Technology reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 654 million, a 9.67% increase over 2023, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 27.1 million, a 206.84% increase. Total assets reached RMB 1.36 billion, up 14.79% year-over-year. The company has shown steady growth with increasing R&D investment (5.36% of revenue) and expanding production capacity, particularly in TAC film projects.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-reliability, and technologically advanced light guide plates that support ultra-thin, narrow bezel, high-resolution, and low-power display trends. Its proprietary prism dot technology enhances brightness without increasing energy consumption, offering a 5-12% brightness improvement. The TAC film business aims to provide domestically produced, high-performance optical films to reduce dependence on imports, supporting the localization and sustainability of the display panel supply chain.
